pin.title: Hlobe Street, Greenpoint, Khayelitsha (map point approximate): four men shot dead and eight wounded in tavern shooting, 21 Nov
pin.location_note: APPROXIMATE MAP POINT. MaDlamini's Place tavern, Hlobe Street, Greenpoint informal settlement, Khayelitsha. Not in Nominatim; the pin is the Khayelitsha point (-34.0416, 18.7082). Area level, about 3 km.

note: Research only. Nothing here is published until a record in docs/signals/location-photos.json is approved by the owner.
